title: PermissionDescriptor
description: Defines a custom permission created through the designer. Supports parent-child hierarchy.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: use stable dot-separated permission names, for example `Acme.Events.Create`. Define a parent permission for the feature and child permissions for operations. Pages and endpoints can reference these names. Permission definitions only declare permissions; roles/users must still be granted permissions through permission management. Children inherit the parent `app` unless they set their own.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference used when this descriptor is stored as a model descriptor file.

name.description: Unique dot-separated permission name, for example 'Acme.Events.Create'.

app.description: Name of the low-code app that owns this permission. Omit for the default app. Must match an apps[].name. Child permissions inherit it when omitted.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name shown in permission management UI.

children.description: Child permissions forming a hierarchy. Use for feature -> operation grouping.

extendsLowerLayer.description: When true, this descriptor overrides selected fields of a permission with the same name defined in a lower model layer; displayName becomes optional.
